title: POST /capture, a capture by its fields
description: A webhook, CI job or shortcut saves one memory with a capture token (contracts/README.md section 6). A body with text and only these fields is a capture by them; any other JSON object is kept whole (capture_webhook.input.schema.json).

text.description: The memory's text: not blank, at most 131072 bytes of UTF-8. Text that reads like instructions, holds hidden characters or runs past 32 KiB is held for a person's review.

tags.description: Words to find it by. A tag in a namespace the engine sets itself is left off and named in the answer.

scope.description: The token's one scope, if the caller wants that checked: private (personal) or shared (Family, company). Any other scope is refused (403).

project.description: A project in the token's scope, made when new, as a write names one.

source.description: Where it came from, such as ci or shortcut; capture when absent. Never one of the engine's own channels.

mirror.description: The outside item's id: this memory mirrors it. The same token capturing the same id again changes that memory, and nothing else may change it while the connection stands.

idempotencyKey.description: The same key and request apply once. May come in the Idempotency-Key header instead.
